question:
Arrange the parts to form a correct sentence:
P: the students
Q: organized a campaign
R: on plastic pollution
S: last week at school
solution:
The correct answer is** Option (1)** i.e. **PQRS**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence begins with **part P**, "the students," which introduces the subject of the sentence.
 
• Following this, **part Q**, "organized a campaign," specifies the action performed by the students.
